name: Cactus
style: low-poly, flat colours, a smooth saguaro column with two upturned arms (Quaternius 2019)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: The plan's source (a Quaternius static cactus on poly.pizza) is behind a Cloudflare challenge; this is Cactus_3 from Quaternius's Ultimate Nature Pack on OpenGameArt (License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0), the same zip and pin as the tree, tree-palm, lilypad and other plant entries, so they read as one set. Of the ten cacti in the pack (Cactus_1-5, CactusFlower_1, CactusFlowers_2-5) it is the classic saguaro: one tall column with two upturned arms on opposite sides, a clean silhouette at a glance. Cactus_1 is an armless spiny barrel, Cactus_4/5 and CactusFlowers_4/5 are prickly-pear pads, CactusFlower_1 is a wide agave-like rosette, Cactus_2 has three stubby arms bunched on one side, and CactusFlowers_2/3 are saguaros with spiky pink crowns that turn into noise at a distance. Height 3.5 m: a saguaro starts growing arms at roughly 2-4 m (desert-film saguaros run 3-6 m); at 3.5 m it stands about twice a 1.6 m person, the arms springing at 1.7-2.2 m. The arms lie in one plane, so ingest.yaw -64 turns that plane to face between the front and hero cameras: the arms spread in the front, three-quarter and hero views (only the side views see them end-on). Colours on noon (no green), as the other plants: the body is vermilion (accent) shading to iris, the set's foliage colour. Smooth, one material, no spines. Static: no clips.
